description:
Store::insert_message_with_attachments() (kith-store/src/lib.rs:897) takes 16 positional arguments and is decorated with #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]. The adjacent insert_outbound_message() was correctly converted to use OutboundMessageParams struct.

insert_message_with_attachments is called by Peer/deliver (kith-peer) and inbound delivery paths. The two functions have 13 parameters in common. Introducing an InboundMessageParams struct (mirroring OutboundMessageParams) would:
- Remove the clippy suppression
- Make call sites self-documenting (named fields vs positional)
- Allow new parameters to be added without updating every call site

This is a refactor of existing code, not new functionality.
title: insert_message_with_attachments has too_many_arguments suppression instead of a params struct
